integrity: The all-n formulas follow from a direct block decomposition and exact flip count. Two independently implemented exhaustive methods were run against the final finding, using Python 3 standard library. Their common finite degree histograms agree, but the finite computations alone are not used to prove the infinite theorem. No independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed-position unit-domino tilings in rectangular two-by-two-by-n boxes, n>=1, under elementary four-cube switches. Does not establish shortest paths, mixing rates or analogous claims for thicker boxes. Connectivity was previously known. Priority remains subject to unindexed literature and independent mathematical review.
title: Sharp flip mobility in \(2\times2\times n\) domino boxes
